name: Vanthorpe Thermoveil Executive Blazer
description: A peak-lapel blazer in near-black with an almost imperceptible navy warp thread, constructed from Vanthorpe's Thermoveil — a climate-regulating fabric that adjusts to body temperature within a two-degree range. The shoulder is bespoke-cut with a chrome arm channel hidden behind a functioning pocket square slot. No visible branding; the lining is a dense Tibetan-Brazilian geometric print visible only when the jacket is opened.
functionality: Active thermal regulation, chrome arm shoulder channel, privacy-weave exterior that diffuses scan attempts.
what_it_says: You do not need anyone to know who made this — and everyone who matters already does.
story_hooks: The privacy-weave exterior blocks standard corporate scan frequencies — wearing it into a secured building without disclosure is a criminal offense in three of the six Meridian districts.
One was left behind after a closed-door merger negotiation; whoever retrieves it first holds leverage — the lining contains handwritten notation in a cipher.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, architectural peak-lapel blazer that reads as almost pure black in most lighting, with an ultra-subtle navy warp creating a barely-perceptible directional sheen. The silhouette is precisely tailored with sharp shoulder angles and a confident, commanding presence. The garment appears to absorb light rather than reflect it.
physical_description.fit: Bespoke tailored — shoulders cut with mathematical precision, allowing subtle room for augmented arm movement. The torso is fitted without restriction, the sleeves taper cleanly to the wrist. Designed for someone with a slight cybernetic shoulder retrofit or natural athletic frame.
physical_description.primary_material: Vanthorpe Thermoveil — a proprietary synthetic blend with embedded thermal-regulating microfibers that maintain homeostasis within ±1°C of optimal body temperature
physical_description.texture: Deceptively smooth to the eye; up close, a microscopic jacquard weave creates subtle topographical variation. The fabric has a barely-perceptible grip, neither slick nor matte — premium and restrained
physical_description.color_scheme: Near-black (near-IR neutral) with an invisible navy warp thread visible only under specific angles and lighting. The interior lining is a dense, intricate geometric print combining Tibetan knot patterns with Brazilian modernist tessellations in deep jewel tones — emerald, sapphire, bronze
physical_description.closures: Three magnetic snap points hidden within the peak lapels; single magnetic closure at the waist. The functioning pocket square slot uses a friction-fit mechanism for secure but silent fastening
distinctive_features: Chrome arm channel concealed behind functioning right-side pocket square slot — provides clear passage for augmented limb data cables without visible seams
Invisible navy warp thread — status symbol only visible to those who know to look
Elaborate interior lining only visible when jacket is opened — deliberate contradiction of corpo restraint
Bespoke shoulder cut accommodates cybernetic shoulder augmentation with zero visual compromise
Zero visible branding — confidence of true Tier 1 luxury
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury — the price point is architectural rather than visible
physical_description.cultural_context: Upper-echelon corpo executive, likely in biotech, neural architecture, or high-frequency trading. Wearer is augmented but deliberately obscures it. Projects quiet dominance and technical sophistication. Someone who has moved beyond ostentatious chrome.
physical_description.condition_typical: Immaculate when worn — Thermoveil fabric resists wrinkles and environmental contamination. May show subtle compression marks at the shoulder seams from repeated augmentation interface docking, read by informed observers as a badge of active cyber-enhancement
